messages:
Jordan (Sales): Quick heads up — AcmeHealth legal/security pushed back on our POC ask. They want: SIG/CAIQ subset answers, an LOA saying which ISMS controls apply for the POC, and explicit KMS details. Also asking whether the POC can run on Hosted (fast) vs Dedicated (isolation) and what the delta in pricing is. Can we outline what we can provide and a realistic timeline?

Priya (Security): Short version: we can provide SIG/CAIQ mappings + a LOA stub. For KMS: Hosted uses Redwood-managed keys by default (no customer key). Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS (BYOK) with AWS KMS / GCP KMS. Private/VPC supports HSM integr. For the POC we typically offer Dedicated with a temporary BYOK flow (ephemeral key alias) — that meets most vendor control reviewers.

Eli (Solutions): Agree with Priya. Things I can ship: LOA template, control-to-policy mapping doc, network/dataflow diagram, list of subprocessors, sample retention policy, and a cooked evidence pack (logs screenshots, config exports). Timeline estimate: LOA + mapping = 2 business days, evidence pack (assembled + redacted) = 3 business days, Dedicated POC provisioning = 2-4 business days after order, Hosted = immediate but no customer KMS.

Sam (SalesOps): Pricing note — for POC we can do either: 1) Hosted: free trial credits up to X tokens, 2) Dedicated trial: discounted daily flat fee (typical POC rate = $1,200/day for a small instance pool) — we can discount further for multi-week POCs. If customer needs BYOK that's only on Dedicated/Private so pricing follows Dedicated. I can pull a formal quote if we lock scope.

Jordan (Sales): Customer asked specifically: "do logs contain raw customer text?" and "what's the LOA look like for scope-limited POC (no production data)?"

Priya (Security): Logs: we persist request metadata and for Hosted we do not retain full request text by default — we can enable logging for debug on a per-POC basis but we redact or TTL the payloads. On Dedicated/Private you control log retention and can route to your SIEM. LOA: we mark which ISMS controls are in-scope for the POC (eg. access mgmt, encryption, patch mgmt) and explicitly exclude org-wide policies that are not exercised (eg. long-term retention, HR controls). I can attach a one-page LOA statement.

Jordan (Sales): Awesome. Can you paste the LOA skeleton here so I can send to the customer?

Priya (Security): Sure — LOA skeleton below (short):

```
Letter of Applicability — POC (AcmeHealth)
- Scope: Redwood Inference hosted Dedicated pool for POC only.
- Included controls: A.9 (access control), A.10 (cryptography) — encryption in transit + at rest with provider-managed or customer-managed KMS per deployment, A.12 (operational procedures).
- Excluded controls: A.7 (HR onboarding), A.14 (secure development lifecycle for customer code).
- Evidence provided: control mapping excel, network diagram, KMS config example, subprocessors list, sample audit extracts.
- Retention/Logging: POC logs retained for 30 days unless agreed otherwise.
```

Eli (Solutions): For KMS config example (for their infra folks):

```yaml
kms:
  provider: aws-kms
  key_alias: "alias/redwood-poc-acme"
  customer_managed: true
  rotate: false  # POC only
```

Eli (Solutions): Note: ephemeral BYOK flow = we accept a key alias and restrict usage to the POC pool. Security/Legal signs a short addendum.

Sam (SalesOps): I uploaded a draft quote + POC T&Cs to the deal folder: https://redwood.internal/sales/deals/ACME-123/quote (internal). If they want Dedicated for 2 weeks we can set 
- setup fee waiver (60% for trial)
- daily POC rate: see sheet.

evidence-bot: New evidence request created: EVID-4123. Assignee: Priya (Security). Attachments: LOA-skeleton.docx, control-mapping.xlsx.

Jordan (Sales): Customer follow-up: they want the SIG spreadsheet subset filled for the POC (confidentiality, crypto, logging). Can we deliver the SIG subset with short plain-English answers?

Priya (Security): Yes — I can do a focused SIG/CAIQ subset (about 12 Qs) and add links to evidence. ETA: 2 business days.

Eli (Solutions): Also ask them to confirm: expected QPS, sample sequence lengths, and whether they will send PHI. That will decide whether we require Private deployment.

Jordan (Sales): They said low QPS (<50 rps) and synthetic test data — no PHI for the POC. Sounds like Dedicated is fine. I'll confirm BYOK is required.

Sam (SalesOps): Once BYOK is confirmed I can spin the Dedicated trial quote and mark setup as expedited. Jordan — ping me when you have confirmation and I’ll update the quote and SLA stub. :thumbsup:

Priya (Security): I'll draft the SIG subset and LOA, and attach the control mapping. If legal needs a cert chain or a deeper artifact we escalate to security-eng but for now this should clear the vendor review.

Jordan (Sales): Perfect — thanks all. I'll loop in AcmeHealth and ask for confirmation on BYOK + test dates.

Eli (Solutions): If they want a demo runbook I can provide a step-by-step to get their engineers started (kube creds, test client, and sample prompts).

Jordan (Sales): OK next steps: 1) Priya: SIG subset + LOA (2 business days) — assign EVID-4123 2) Sam: prepare Dedicated trial quote pending BYOK 3) Eli: POC runbook + evidence exports. Will update customer tonight.

Priya (Security): On it.

Sam (SalesOps): Standby for the quote.

Eli (Solutions): Happy to help with the runbook.

Jordan (Sales): Closing loop — thanks team :raised_hands:
